set.body:
Type: implementation task
Work key: CX01.1
Epic: CX (core curation flow and console polish)
Source: console walkthrough 2026-10-15 (demo data, 1440x900 and 390x844)

Scope: A single pure mapping from a finding (code, path, facts) to a correction intent: which document to edit or create, and what to suggest.

Acceptance criteria:
1. MriRepetitionTimeMismatch maps to Add sidecar at the run's own path (stem + .json) suggesting RepetitionTime = the header volume spacing from the finding's facts, merged with any existing run-level sidecar content.
2. Events*/BehaviouralTable/ResponseTime findings map to Correct on the named .tsv with the finding's rows flagged; Dwi* findings map to Correct on the .bval/.bvec named.
3. Findings with no safe edit (e.g. MriTransformUnavailable, header-only facts) map to "Open file" only; the mapping never invents a value it cannot derive from recorded facts.
4. The mapping lives in one function with a table of codes; unknown codes fall back to "Open file".

Verification: `bash scripts/check-console.sh` (new guarded probes, current source 0 failures) and, where noted, `bash scripts/check-console-backend.sh`. Add a probe table asserting the intent for each code family in the demo.

Starting code:
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/demo.js (finding codes and facts)
set.title: CX01.1: Map finding codes to correction intents
